facts.text: Jolene experienced a significant setback with her project, resulting in the loss of all her work last week.

evidence.quote: Last week, I had a huge setback with my project. I put in so much work and it all crashed and I lost everything.

facts.text: Jolene mentioned that Susie, a pet, has been providing support and comfort during difficult times.

evidence.quote: Susie really helps when times get tough. Pets have been great company.

facts.text: Jolene adopted Susie two years ago when she was feeling lonely and in need of companionship.

evidence.quote: I adopted her two years ago when I was feeling lonely and wanted some company.
